# ship-feedback

Your interface to the `feedback` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Commands

- [`feedback.post`](references/docs/feedback.post.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Post feedback (canvas/observation; rate-limited).
